open: Samudaya. Plan together, participate together, and spend transparently.
problem: Festival funds, fully accounted for: who paid, who approved, and where the money went.
home: Every festival on one screen: what has been raised, and which flats have paid.
event: Readiness you can see: jobs done, jobs without an owner, and where volunteers are short.
pay: Residents pay in two taps, by UPI or cash, with the payment note filled in for them.
todo: The committee works from one queue: payments, bills, residents and ideas, costliest delays first.
confirm: Each payment is checked against its UPI screenshot, and you can't confirm your own, unless you are the whole committee.
money: Confirmed payments go on a ledger every resident can read, with the name, flat and method on each one.
bills: Money out follows the same rule: every bill attached, and every approval with a name on it.
budget: Spending is tracked against the budget, line by line, and overspends are shown, not hidden.
reconcile: Paste in the bank statement, and it is matched against the ledger. Anything unexplained is flagged.
closure: When a festival closes, the committee decides openly what happens to what is left, and the decision carries a name.
balance: And the society's balance is on every home screen, with every movement explained.
